rewardPolicy.completedRole: completed lessons taken as student only
rewardPolicy.funding: platform fee; original coach payout preserved
rewardPolicy.coachCoupons: no new claims or applications; previously coach-earned coupons cannot be applied after switching to student
rewardPolicy.existingStudentCoupons: existing issued student coupons retain original validity; no additional monthly claim

coachUi: Monthly completed teaching count only; no coupon goal, claim button, wallet entry or apply action. Existing reservations can still be removed.
paymentScope: Live payment gateway remains disabled; coupon eligibility in optional payment preparation is covered by unit and Firestore emulator tests.
verification: Management API and unauthenticated rejection probes; no synthetic production lessons or coupons.
